requirements: Add src/registry.js, an in-memory registry of host sessions bound to projects: bind and unbind sessions (an unbound session is retired and may never bind again), attach records the run a bound session works on, queries return a project's bindings, the bound projects and per-host counts, describe gives a one-line summary, and serialize and deserialize round-trip the registry. reconcile(registry, project) releases every binding of the project whose run is no longer open in the project's run store, read with readStore from src/store-io.js; every bound project has a run store. reconcile runs inside the registry's write lock after every runtime operation, a project's run store can be several megabytes, and a busy project has hundreds of bound sessions.

defects.consequence: reconcile reads and parses the project's multi-megabyte run store once for every binding with a run, so with hundreds of bindings each runtime operation holds the registry write lock for many full parses where one would do.
defects.origin: Registry lock holds grow with session bindings

decoys.consequence: reconcile unbinds sessions while iterating the registry's bindings, so it skips the binding after each one it releases.
decoys.evidence: src/registry.js:51 reconcile unbinds while iterating registry.bindings
decoys.reason: reconcile iterates the array bindingsFor returns, a copy taken before the loop, so unbinding does not disturb the iteration.
